item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.
After the follow-up, the final result is square 1:1 (the user changed the shape from any shape); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it square only and keep everything else the same

style.prompt: Create a polished coffee brand advertisement, square composition. Campaign design system: warm cream background (#F4EBDD), deep dark forest green (#123D30), refined editorial serif brand typography paired with clean sans-serif supporting typography. Hero: photorealistic cream ceramic coffee cup on matching saucer, filled with rich dark coffee, elegant visible wisps of steam, soft natural morning light, subtle realistic shadow. Dark green curved arch graphic behind the cup, restrained premium minimal styling. Layout: generous margins; brand name prominent at top, coffee cup in center, slogan below the hero and clear dark green pill-shaped CTA at bottom. Render exactly these three text elements, with accurate spelling and punctuation: "Daybreak Coffee", "Fresh start. Better coffee.", "Shop now". CTA text cream on green. No other text, no watermark, no extra labels. Strong typographic hierarchy, beautifully balanced negative space, legibility at small sizes. This is the master campaign design to later adapt to portrait and landscape.
